faces.f: When does majestic become ominous?

"Your first reaction may be to stand very still and hope she didn't see you. Trust me, she did."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist
He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. Left without purpose or meaning, he found both in the pits.
Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.
"If you ever want to leave this forest, now's the time."
To become is to understand.

"Let the wild in. Channel its strength."
—Freyalise
When they land on you, all you can think about is tearing them off.
Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.
"Don't laugh. It works."
Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.
"My rule persists beyond death itself."
If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.
Boros soldiers are like a cache of bombs ready to explode, and the flame-kin light their fuses.
The righteous light of Selesnya is channeled through the devout, striking out to blind the nonbelievers.

"Even if we dislodge them, I fear these lands will never again yield crops."
—Kimmick, vanguard knight
To the elves, her spear is a compass; to the boggarts, a harbinger of doom.
No one has properly answered her favorite riddle: "Why should I spare your life?"
Thunder doesn't always mean rain. Sometimes it means ruin.
Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

"I have seen entire civilizations rise and fall. You mortals are but dust to me."
—Sorin Markov

"The blazekite is a simple concept, really—just a vehicular application of dragscoop ionics and electropropulsion magnetronics."
—Juzba, Izzet tinker

"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn
It hears and answers every orison across Shadowmoor.

"If you'd ever met one, you wouldn't ask me to justify the extra provisions for additional security."
—Lorref, caravan master

"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos
It is like life and destiny: we think we know the story, but we have read only half the tale.
Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.
The toymaker frowned in bewilderment. None of his creations had ever sneezed before.
The kor send their thopter kites to see if the land is in a welcoming mood.
It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.
Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

"How could anyone survive this? There is some force at work that stifles even the will to go on."
—Naromin, veteran explorer
Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.

"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle *en*-Vec
An enigma as vexing as life itself.

"It has latched onto this place like an infestation. All efforts at eradication have proved futile."
—Yeter, Trostad villager
She now sees only Emrakul's visions.
Upon discovering what had become of her sisters, Sigarda could only weep.
One silvery blast signaled that she wouldn't be arriving at Thraben alone.
After facing so many horrors, the survivors of Videns parish couldn't comprehend the hope that the gryff represented.
Gideon and Liliana may not have seen eye to eye, but that did not stop them from fighting side by side.
"I will join you so that you will not yet join me."

n: Extricator of Sin // Extricator of Flesh

faces.f: After the end, a new beginning.

"I've seen cathars riding to battle without a hint of fear. Perhaps that is its own sort of madness."
—Esler, Havengul mercenary
She had not believed any shred of humanity remained in these writhing monsters until the twisted form of her partner appeared before her.
The flicker of candlelight and the echo of hymns told the villagers that the monastery wasn't truly abandoned.
She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.
"Get behind me!"
Immune to the physical warping caused by Emrakul, geists proved to be some of humanity's most important allies.
The best weapon is the one at hand.
"Impurities must be pounded out."

n: Lone Rider // It That Rides as One

faces.f:
"Horse and rider are often of one mind."
—Ulda, Gavony Rider

". . . but until this morning, I'd never seen them be of one body."
—Ulda, Gavony Rider
The person who finishes a journey is rarely the same as the one who starts it.

"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor
Not all minds touched by the Eldrazi turn to raging psychosis. Some simply withdraw from this world into memories of a better one.
There is power in prayer, regardless of who is listening.

"Fight for a better future, even if you may not live to see it."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft
"There is always more to give."
The Order of Saint Traft found new strength with Sigarda's support.
Many whose faith was destroyed by Avacyn turned to the only angel who remained true to humanity.

"My predecessors taught me of duty and commitment. It seems they have more to teach."
—Wendin, veteran cathar

"The most resolute soldiers will press forward in the face of overwhelming odds."
—Gideon Jura
The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.
"Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned—at the edge of a sword, if necessary."
"Let the points of our lances lead the way."
The uncorrupted rallied under Thalia's leadership and Sigarda's banner.

"Improvement is a consequence of practice."
—Stitcher Geralf
At Nahiri's call, Emrakul traversed the vast emptiness between the planes and arrived on Innistrad.

"Improvisation is for those who failed to prepare."
—Jace Beleren

"There's no sense arguing with insanity."
—Levana, Midnight Duelist
Good books make you savor each word.
"I'll see you soon, Subjects 25 and 26. I've got a good feeling this time!"
The time had come for him to share his findings.
Some took to their boats to escape the unfolding nightmare. The remains of their vessels now litter the shores of Nephalia.
"At last! Proof that it's not all in my head!"
Amid the gibbering chorus that rose from the drownyard temple, Jace recognized a single word: "Emrakul."
Uncertainty has its own allure.
After reading the final words, it turns back to the first page and begins again.
"There's no question that these waters are treacherous, but if there's one thing I've learned in all my years of sailing . . ."
". . . it's that the lure of the sea is impossible to ignore."
Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.
Heads and shoulders above the rest.
It keeps intruders out and experiments in.
"Moonlight offers sublime warmth that brings me a comfort sunlight cannot provide."
Infinite wisdom cannot be contained within a single mind.
"The answer's in here somewhere!"
"Let's start fresh, shall we?"
A place for everything, and everything in its place.
When the Nebelgast recedes, there are often stragglers.

"There are tides beyond those in the sea that are driven by Innistrad's silver moon. If you learn their patterns, you can channel them in fascinating ways."
—Tamiyo

"Nicely done, Jace. You always were good at disappearing acts."
—Liliana Vess
All around Emrakul, life re-formed in her image.
"There's a smoothness to my magic here that I don't find on any other plane."
Some spirits cling to one person, feasting on the growing fear until a final moment of all-consuming terror.
Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.
The Voldaren lands remained well protected when Olivia's army marched from Lurenbraum Fortress.

"We entered the church in search of solace, but it became clear we wouldn't find it there."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess
The surviving members of the Markov bloodline drove through a crush of horrors to reclaim their ancestral home.
"It's not work if you enjoy it."
"I'll keep watch. Happy now?"
Displays of Voldaren bloodlust are not restricted to glamorous banquets and lavish parties.
What remained of the Lunarch Inquisition found new ways to extract confessions.

"Don't get too comfortable in there."
—Liliana Vess

"Do try to pull your weight, Geralf. I feel like I'm doing everything."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

"I can no longer stand by as these Skirsdag infiltrators rot the church from within. Even the Lunarch Council is compromised. What a fool I've been."
—Odric

"Blood from the vein is the finest vintage to accompany a feast of the mind."
—Runo Stromkirk
"Restraint is for the meek."
The famed hunting hounds of House Cecani continue to prove the quality of their pedigree.
There will be no absolution.
Not all monsters have tentacles.
Even if the rain turned to blood, her thirst would not be slaked.

"Don't worry, sweet brother. Help is on the way."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

"Emrakul makes apparent those whom she has favored."
—Runo Stromkirk
Your thoughts are no longer your own.

"Impressive."
—Chandra Nalaar
There is always a toll to pay for passage.
"Some claim that rage is a cloud that obscures thought and vision. But I can assure you—I've never seen with greater clarity."
Burning with hatred for Nahiri, the Voldaren and Markov forces assaulted the warped Markov Manor with a collective fury not seen in centuries.
With fewer patrols about, Kessig's roads have become prime hunting grounds.

n: Conduit of Storms // Conduit of Emrakul

faces.f: It strikes with the fury of a tempest.
As without, so within.

"When you confront a wolf scorned by its pack, extra caution is the order of the day."
—Raf Gyel of the Quiver of Kessig

"Each day there are new reports of homes along Getander Pass and Hofsaddel falling to vampires of a more savage nature. I've even heard tell that Anje Falkenrath has returned. Please send whatever help you can."
—Sterin Gorn, letter to Thalia
"Writhe all you want, filth. It will do you no good."
Geist-powered devices have no shortage of fuel.
"We're ready for anything!"
"Such an adorable face!"

"What's your plan?" Gideon asked.
"Are you serious?" Chandra replied.

"Drink deeply, for there is no tomorrow!"
—Anje Falkenrath
A tidy desk is as good as an invitation.
"You brought this upon yourself, Sorin!"
A tiny crack is enough to open the mind to Emrakul.
"Keep your herons and shrews! You will find nothing in the moon, for the moon is a lie! It has told me so!"
A few gnawing thoughts can eat at the mind until nothing else remains.

"Never thought I'd see the day I'd be wishing to see just a plain old werewolf."
—Raf Gyel of the Quiver of Kessig

". . . heck, I'd settle for anything that even resembled a werewolf."
—Raf Gyel of the Quiver of Kessig

"Hang on. I'm just tidying up."
—Chandra Nalaar

"We can't win a war on an empty stomach, can we?"
—Olivia Voldaren
"The perils of the road, you say? Don't worry. You won't have to face those again."
"Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."
These new terrors will not recede with the setting of the moon.
"Lightning in a bottle? That's not where I need it."
Paranoia has driven some Kessig communities to hunt down anything—and anyone—that travels through their woods.

"There is a sourness here that I don't understand. When the land reaches out to me, I hesitate to reach back."
—Nissa Revane

"What worked to bring down angels will do the same for these horrors."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Eldrazi
"May the steel of your blade match the steel in your soul."

"In times like these, be particularly wary of those who claim they can save your soul."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig
Hordes of Eldrazi and cultists swarmed over Thraben's defenses, and the members of the Gatewatch found themselves overrun.
As Emrakul's influence radiated across Innistrad, evacuation from Kessig's remote villages became increasingly difficult.
Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.
"Bloodsuckers, howlers, monsters from the beyond . . . it doesn't much matter. I won't have to face them alone."
In the wake of Emrakul, some werewolves' human forms were lost forever.
A different kind of transformation has taken place.

"More rope may not be necessary."
—Kep, Lunarch inquisitor
Woodland geists concluded that Emrakul would be unable to warp the denizens of the forest if the geists got there first.
The Somberwald has become a hunting ground for the Dronepack, the group of werewolves that have succumbed to the flesh-twisting power of Emrakul.
"The power of the woods is only ever borrowed."

"A werewolf's howl is terrifying, to be sure. But this . . . this was a chilling sound I somehow felt. I fear what will reply to it."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig
Despite the reemergence of werewolves and the proliferation of Eldrazi, elk numbers in the Somberwald have remained steady.
The bonds of the pack transcend time and death.

"No matter how much a plane has suffered, there is a way to restore it."
—Nissa Revane

"Every evil destroyed is a strike against the enemy."
—Erold, Gatstaf springsage
Its web is woven so tightly that not even geists can avoid capture.

"What has long, flesh-rending claws and enormous, bone-crushing teeth?"
—Halana, Kessig ranger

". . . because to be honest, I couldn't tell you."
—Halana, Kessig ranger

"Even on a plane as dark as this one, nature will organize a defense against the unnatural."
—Nissa Revane

"The Eldrazi are all too practiced at twisting natural into unnatural."
—Nissa Revane

"I tell you, the trees were closing in! It's by the grace of the Heron alone that I made it out of the Ulvenwald!"
—Ricton, traveling merchant

"Show them what it means to be the source of nightmares!"
—Ulrich, Krallenhorde alpha
The magic used by Kessigers is known for its practical applications.
Each had seen friends and family taken by the corruption, so each carried an axe at the other's request.

"There is no saving this world, not anymore. But we shall be its bloody vengeance."
—Sorin Markov

"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."
Sigarda was the last uncorrupted archangel, but she would not have to fight alone.

"Procedural misstep: provocation of geists for the purpose of yielding more energy can compromise containment units. Next action: clean up mess."
—Laboratory notes
The Order of Saint Traft cleared the roads of cultists and horrors, opening the way for the villagers to flee Thraben.

n: Ulrich of the Krallenhorde // Ulrich, Uncontested Alpha

faces.f:
"A leader can inspire courage, but it is the smiths and healers who truly keep hope alive."
—Thalia, heretic cathar

"I felt compelled to take the twisted stone, and I abandoned my horse's burden to accommodate its weight. Now, its continued glow illuminates my home and warms my mind."
—Garner Kroft, Moorland farmer
The head of the staff doubles as a brand to anoint the newly inducted.
As it walks across the fallow field, its awkward, loping gait matches the rattling in its head to create a haunting rhythm that chills the bones.

"It'll keep the crows away. Works on neighbors too."
—Old Rutstein

"Ludevic saw it in a dream and set to work immediately, every detail already known. Can such genius be taught?"
—Stitcher Geralf

"Don't stop chopping until the pieces stop wiggling."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Eldrazi
Sometimes the weapon wields the bearer.
All are welcome.

"May knowledge be our sanctuary."
—Yora, academy researcher
Both sculptor and sculpted.
With each iteration, the database grows closer to original thought.
"Progress always has a price."

"The better you understand how a planet is made, the better you understand how one is unmade."
—Ulix, Eumidian terrademolitionist
Every world is a new garden.
Within moxite lies the ability for a ship's drive to pierce the Chaos Wall. Without it, the Edge becomes much smaller.
Sothera collapses, but its light is not yet gone.
A conductor for an electric symphony.
Eumidians do their work knowing that only future generations will see it finished.
Evendo's microbial life swiftly adapted to metabolize the leaking star fuel, devouring it like any other nourishment.
Iridescent debris and chromatic chemical fires litter Kavaron with the beauty of destruction.

"The Tapestry weaves worlds on its own. All we do is tend to the process."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

"New things need room to grow. We prune time so the future can flourish."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

"Progress always has a price."

"The better you understand how a planet is made, the better you understand how one is unmade."
—Ulix, Eumidian terrademolitionist

Iridescent debris and chromatic chemical fires litter Kavaron with the beauty of destruction.

"The Tapestry weaves worlds on its own. All we do is tend to the process."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

"New things need room to grow. We prune time so the future can flourish."
—Antioxa, Drix elder
The divine light of the Palatinate could be so cold. As she laid down her sword, she felt the sun's warmth in a different way.
In the end, the dying Illvoi clung to neither secrecy nor protocol. She cloudsculpted wings that she might live on in a spark of creativity.
Despite all the differences between the Edge and the Multiverse, people still spoke the language of greed.
Tezzeret grinned as he realized Mm'menon was right: he had much to learn.
The importance of using updated Pinnacle codebooks is a lesson learned only once.
Eumidians live to change and be changed, ever increasing the complexity of the Edge. Each new world is a new perspective.
"Regrowth is as inevitable as the tragedy that necessitates it."

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls.
II — Search your library for a Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
III — Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn.

faces.f:
"An ordered Sothera is a peaceful Sothera. Join the Strategic Corps today and proudly turn the gears of progress!"
—Pinnacle recruitment ad
The advent of cloudsculpting ended the use of mechanical locks in Illvoi society.
Like the Astelli, born of consumed stars.

"All creation in a single point, the point of all creation in all."
—Sunstar loop-mantra

"Sunstar hypocrites speak of peace but march to war. Only we sing truth."
—Xu-Ifit, osteoharmonist

"Thus, the shattered half of the planet was named Kavaron That Is, and the capital was moved to Kavaron Before."
*—The Tragedy of Emperor Kavarus III*
For many children, the wonder of their first warp is a lifelong inspiration.
The ice that grips Evendo hides a world coveted by both the Eumidians and the Καν.
On the border of the Chaos Wall that separates the Edge from the Blind Eternities, creation itself still churns.
Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

"Technology evolves faster than a blade can swing."
—Arima, lead inventor of the Futurists
Its graceful glide paints the ocean floor with strokes of luminescence.
The greatest masters of the craft abandon tools altogether, shaping metal with hand and mind alone.

"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop
It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.
Few outside the Saiba Futurists know the true extent of their data-extraction network.
Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.
"They were all laughing at you after you left, you know. How will you make them pay?"

"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain
All the world is Purphoros's anvil.
"Could someone bring me more evidence markers? Like...a lot more?"

"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might
All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
"While the church thinks in terms of legacies, others think in terms of eternities."
No spot in nature is truly barren.
"Give me just a moment. I need to grow us a new bridge."
From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.
A thousand years of history undone by one juvenile prank.

"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

"Roots find their way through rock, and even mountains must give way to new growth."
—Nissa Revane
The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.
"Flowstone spreads, but new life spreads faster."

"These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again. Now, their patience is rewarded."
—Wrenn
No one knew why the spiritmongers were so enraged by Phyrexian technology, but it was a stroke of good luck for the Coalition.
"Greetings, fellow inventors!" the akki shouted, attempting a friendly smile. To her dismay, the greeting was met only with shrieks and alarms being activated.
The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.
Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.
As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.
"What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."
Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.
Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.
The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.

"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

"Let all feel joy in pain."
—Rakdos

"Belong in a museum? I think we should let relics belong wherever they please!"
—Quintorius, Lorehold mage-student
Not all who remember Urza do so with fondness.
"Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"
It converts the faintest surges of power from Mirrodin's core into usable energy, providing endless power for Memnarch's creations on the surface.
Magic, unlike physics, has no unbreakable laws.
There are few problems that can't be solved by putting a hole in the world.

"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer
Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.
Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.
History has buried its treasures deep.
So long as the Halo keeps flowing, the festivities never end.
Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.
On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.
The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.
No self-respecting criminal has a basement with only one exit.
The land is ever resilient. Should it die, it will be reborn.

"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist
Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.
Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

"I can't protect everyone here. But those I can, I will."
—Karn
Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*
Only extraordinary performers are invited to grace the grandest stage in New Capenna.
As the Invasion Tree grew, its branches pierced through the world's silent core.
Through sun and storm, across steppe and swamp, Storm Crane Monastery flies wherever aid is needed.
The path to unity is forged in understanding.
Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.
Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.
The path to strength is forged in stability.
Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.
The boiling seas around Shiv provided a welcome layer of protection for the reclaimed Mana Rig.
The path to genius is forged in creativity.
From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.
The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.
A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira
Everything is flammable in the Burning Isles, even the mana itself.
As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.
Life and death mixing together, both ends of the same cycle giving rise to something else.
"You again?"
An intelligent jetpack for those who find themselves lost in space.
"Stygian demon! You are sentenced to ten cycles of illumination. May the light scour the shadow from your soul."
As the supervoid's photon collar washed over them, time stopped. Their souls would experience the grandeur of their demise for eternity.
"My purpose is my spear. My spear is my life. My life is for the Regent Maximum."
Cosmogrands of the Celestial Palatinate always seek to expand their grip on the Edge.
"Arrive as the dawn, and banish night through your brilliance!"
Eternity columns are the trade hubs of every solar system.

"You fight beside me as brilliantly as the dawn. I have nothing more to teach you."
—Master Iridiss

"Haste begets blunder. Be patient, Aora. As the sun rises, you will yet earn your second blade."
—Master Iridiss
"This is your captain speaking. Our eternity drive has ruptured. Light be with you all."
"An Astelli once saved me just like this. I aspire to live up to their example every day."
The hidden might of the Sunstar Free Company is its technical staff.

"We are the arrows of Sunsolde's Quiver."
—*Declaration of Fleet Purpose*, Axiom 2

"I have forgotten sleep in their prison."
—Korelaa, prison escapee
"With this mantle, you carry the duty to spread light, liberty, and the grace of Taman IV to the stars."
"Hope can never fade so long as there's a hand to carry my sword when I fall."
"I thank you that I do not shine alone."
Born of dead stars, the Astelli may fight for light, but they know the void as their womb.

"Only when a vessel is emptied of shallow ego may the depths of light flow in to fill it."
—Seraphus Chek, Sunstar poet

"The light does not ask permission to cut through the darkness."
—Mentor Ultimate, to Regent Maximum Taman IV

"We've received transmission! They're alive—just barely."
—Sunstar Free Company Mission Control
Drix hunt down Eldrazi Potentiate without hesitation or explanation.
"Brightstar-1 to FlightComm: Scopes are clear. The stars are yours."
"You are a suspect in an ongoing investigation. Do not resist apprehension."
She forges blades of incandescence and quenches them in pitch darkness.
His people watched the Eldrazi rise and the Fomori fall. Never will they watch again.
The Sunstar Free Company is not swayed by profit. Sunstar is their faith, the prism through which they cast light across Sothera.
"Your ship and crew have been contaminated by the great destroyers. We cannot risk their spread. Prepare for unraveling."
When packing for a stealth mission, it's important to fold your dimensions tightly.
All Uthros networks are routed through an ancient relic called a memory vessel, which converts data into thought.
A cloudsculptor at work is like a carefully balanced weather system, and just as dangerous to interfere with.
Even across the Edge, a dog is still a dog.
Older than the Eumidian seedships that populated Evendo.
Illvoi are masters of the deep freeze, though conditions must be perfect to avoid going to pieces.
"Your atoms will serve my ambitions in a much more useful form."
Illvoi hope for the best outcomes but engineer for the worst.
Emissary mechans are often assigned their own security detail given their importance in inter-Pinnacle dialogs.
